parties.respondent: A. Santha (Dead) Through Lrs. And Ors.

summary: Hindu coparcenary rights of unmarried daughters under Tamil Nadu Amendment Act; status conferred w.e.f. 25.03.1989; partition claim post-specific performance decree; applicability to plaint schedule property; partial partition deed dated 24.02.1980; validity of conveyance to third-party purchaser; binding effect of prior decree in Appeal No.165/1984; preclusion of declaratory relief against confirmed judgment; analysis of Vineeta Sharma and Ravi precedents; courts below correctly held property ceased to be HUF pre-amendment; plaintiff bound by partial partition acceptance.
legal_provisions_cited: Hindu Succession Act, 1956 (Tamil Nadu Amendment) s.29A
Suhrid Singh Alias Sardool Singh v. Randhir Singh
final_judgment: Civil Appeal dismissed; impugned judgments upheld; plaintiff's partition claim rejected.
